result:
If I could change the world in one way, I would make **mutual understanding the default setting of human interaction**.

Not “no conflict,” because conflict can be useful, but something like: when people encounter differences, their first instinct would be to try to understand each other clearly and fairly before deciding how to respond.

That one change might reduce a huge amount of unnecessary harm — in politics, relationships, work, education, and daily life. A lot of what makes the world painful comes from misunderstanding, fear, and the feeling of being unseen. If people could more easily hear and be heard, even with their disagreements, the world would become more creative, more compassionate, and more capable of solving problems together.
